We do not trade on the platforms we review and we take no referral position in the verdict. We read the pages, verify what is verifiable, and score what remains.
whatItClaims: 9 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
whatWeChecked: The broker relationship: which partner desk executes orders.
The asset list: how many pairs are actually offered.
The registration flow: what personal details the form collects.
The risk disclosure: where the capital-at-risk wording sits.
The security claims: encryption and account protection statements.
The withdrawal path: steps and any fees the page omits.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Enter your name, email, phone and country, then confirm through the emailed link.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Fund US$250 via card or transfer to activate the trading balance.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your limits, pick a trading mode and let the demo build your confidence first.

pros: Funding by card, transfer, PayPal and Skrill.
cons: The demo claim buried in the signup flow.
Performance examples without dates or proof.
Asset list that shifts between pages.
The headline fee claim and the real cost disagree.
redFlags: A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.
Performance language with no dates attached.
A broker relationship described in one vague sentence.

faqs.q: Is MegaRelated safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.
US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.
9 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

bottomLine: The desk, the demo and the funding options all check out. The score reflects the paperwork around them.
We rate it 4.6 with conditions: the platform is usable, the published claims are not all verifiable, and the US$250 minimum is the right size for testing either.
